mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cart c INNER JOIN cart_item ci ON c.cart_id = ci.cart_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND ci.added_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = c.user_id AND o.ordered_at > ci.added_at ) )

WITH stat AS ( SELECT MAX(ordered_at) AS last_at, (MAX(ordered_at) - MIN(ordered_at)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) - 1, 0) AS avg_gap FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'RETURNED') HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ) SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName FROM stat s JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'RETURNED') JOIN orders_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOW() - s.last_at >= s.avg_gap * 1.5 AND NOW() - s.last_at < s.avg_gap * 2 GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAX(o.ordered_at) DESC LIMIT 1
